text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1874-630, Rim Lock Cylinder Pull Trim for Panic Device

A Pull Trim for a Rim Cylinder, the Don-Jo 1874 simply installs under a lock. It is for use on back doors with Stainless Steel Rim Exit Devices. It has a Satin Stainless Steel Finish.

Features and Specifications of the Don Jo 1874-630 Satin Stainless Steel Rim Cylinder Door Pull:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Width: 2"
  • Length: 3.75 "
  • Projection .665"
  • Cut Out Diameter: 1.25"
  • Thickness: .125"
  • Don-Jo 1874 Door Pull Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
